Manibela Kings [BETA]

🚧 The game is temporarily CLOSED for our Beta overhaul. Join our community server below for dev logs, testing announcements, and updates!

Experience the authentic daily hustle of Philippine transit. Drive iconic public utility jeepneys, master the highways of South Luzon, or commute as a passenger in a living regional economy.

• Rent-to-Own boundary progression & garage customization
• Real-time signboard routing & GPS navigation
